author: Haruko
name: HaruAdmins
short: Persistent timeouts and protection from unapproved bots.
description: Adds hybrid timeout and bot-protection commands, renews long timeouts, and removes unapproved bots on join.
install_msg: HaruAdmins loaded. Use /timeout for member timeouts or /botprotection to configure unapproved-bot removal.
end_user_data_statement: Stores timeout target and moderator Discord IDs, expiration times, and reasons for long timeouts, plus bot-protection role and channel IDs and whitelisted bot IDs.
